nom: Bioderma Hydrabio H2O Micellar Water Face Cleanser for Dehydrated Skin

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, T-zone-prone skin that also dehydrates easily reports this hydrating version feels less drying than the oily-skin Bioderma variant and does not cause breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or crucial-moisture-needing skin report the product removes makeup without stripping or leaving skin feeling tight or dry.
segments.sensitive: Reports are split: some sensitive-skin and sensitive-eye users describe it as gentle and soothing, while others (including a self-described esthetician) report immediate eye burning, redness and swelling.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers who describe their skin as dehydrated or oily-but-dehydrated report the product removes makeup without tightness or added dryness, calling it more hydrating than the original Bioderma formula.
concerns.blemishes: One acne-prone reviewer reports no breakouts or issues from regular use.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report their eyes became red, swollen and irritated after use, contradicting others who describe it as gentle around the eyes.

extraits.texte: I read this was good for sensitive eyes and skin. I don't think I have ever had a worse experience with a MU remover. My eyes immediately burned, and I had bloodshot eyes, which I have never had, even with my very dry eyes. Tread lightly with this. I am a MU artist and esthetician, so not a woman with no experience in this field.
Do not buy. Tried it for the first time and burns your eye. Doesn't take off eye make-up. Eye is red and swollen. Do not recommend.

Removes makeup and sunscreen, very gentle first step cleanser for my skin and non-stripping. I use a separate remover for waterproof mascara, but everything else it can handle. I'm allergic to the pink top Bioderma so I'm very happy with this one.

extraits.titre: Better than the for oily skin version
extraits.texte: My skin is quite oily especially on my t-zone but I can get dehydrated very easily. I like this version because it doesnt feel harsh or drying, which some may think is better for oily skin but drying it can cause more oil production. This product takes makeup off very easily especially if you hold for a few seconds on your eyes for eye makeup removal. I'm also easily acne prone and this hasn't given me any issues. Sometimes I also use it as a quick cleanser in the morning if I feel that my skin is a little sensitive and prefer not to wash with a foaming cleanser.

I've used Bioderma for years, but never tried the hydrating version. I love it! It quickly removes my makeup without making my skin feel tight or dry. It's definitely more hydrating than the original. Highly recommend this!

extraits.titre: Love the blue, switch to pink for winter
extraits.texte: Amazing product, love, love, love. Use this, then some toner. Amazing! Doesn't dry out skin, use a bit of toner after and good to go. For those with stinging in the eyes, I don't use so much product that it gets into my eyes, never had a problem. A little goes a long way. Staple

extraits.titre: I forgot how good a GOOD micellar water is
extraits.texte: I've been buying decent micellar waters for a while for makeup removal at the end of the day, and I forgot how gentle and lovely a GOOD micellar water feels on the skin at the end of the day. It's soothing, gentle, and solidly gets off most of my makeup. Any stubborn bits I can use some pond's cold cream on, and then go back in with this gentle guy before going in with the face wash for the evening. Excited to try others of this micellar brand!
